an3.112:1.3: Atīte bhikkhave chandarāgaṭṭhānīye dhamme ārabbha chando jāyati,
an3.112:1.4: anāgate bhikkhave chandarāgaṭṭhānīye dhamme ārabbha chando jāyati,
an3.112:1.5: paccuppanne bhikkhave chandarāgaṭṭhānīye dhamme ārabbha chando jāyati. 2.
an3.112:1.6: Kathañ ca bhikkhave atīte chandarāgaṭṭhānīye dhamme ārabbha chando jāyati?
an3.112:1.7: Atīte bhikkhave chandarāgaṭṭhānīye dhamme ārabbha cetasā anuvitakketi anuvicāreti.
an3.112:1.8: Tassa atīte chandarāgaṭṭhānīye dhamme ārabbha cetasā anuvitakkayato anuvicārayato chando jāyati,
an3.112:1.10: Etāhaṃ bhikkhave saññojanaṃ vadāmi, yo cetaso sārāgo.
an3.112:1.11: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave atīte chandarāgaṭṭhānīye dhamme ārabbha chando jāyati. 3.
an3.112:2.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave anāgate chandarāgaṭṭhānīye dhamme ārabbha chando jāyati?
an3.112:2.2: Anāgate bhikkhave chandarāgaṭṭhānīye dhamme ārabbha cetasā anuvitakketi anuvicāreti.
an3.112:2.3: Tassa anāgate chandarāgaṭṭhānīye dhamme ārabbha cetasā anuvitakkayato anuvicārayato chando jāyati,
an3.112:2.5: Etāhaṃ bhikkhave saññojanaṃ vadāmi, yo cetaso sārāgo.
an3.112:2.6: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave anāgate chandarāgaṭṭhānīye dhamme ārabbha chando jāyati. 4.
an3.112:3.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave paccuppanne chandarāgaṭṭhānīye dhamme ārabbha chando jāyati?
an3.112:3.2: Paccuppanne bhikkhave chandarāgaṭṭhānīye dhamme ārabbha cetasā anuvitakketi anuvicāreti.
an3.112:3.3: Tassa paccuppanne chandarāgaṭṭhānīye dhamme ārabbha cetasā anuvitakkayato anuvicārayato chando jāyati,
an3.112:3.5: Etāhaṃ bhikkhave saññojanaṃ vadāmi, yo cetaso sārāgo.
an3.112:3.6: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave paccuppanne chandarāgaṭṭhānīye dhamme ārabbha chando jāyati.
an3.112:3.7: Imāni kho bhikkhave tīṇi nidānāni kammānaṃ samudayāya. 110.1 1.
an3.112:4.1: Tīṇ' imāni bhikkhave nidānāni kammānaṃ samudayāya.
an3.112:4.3: Atīte bhikkhave chandarāgaṭṭhānīye dhamme ārabbha chando na jāyati,
an3.112:4.4: anāgate bhikkhave chandarāgaṭṭhānīye dhamme ārabbha chando na jāyati,
an3.112:4.5: paccuppanne bhikkhave chandarāgaṭṭhānīye dhamme ārabbha chando na jāyati. 2.
an3.112:5.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave atīte chandarāgaṭṭhānīye dhamme ārabbha chando na jāyati?
an3.112:5.2: Atītānam bhikkhave chandarāgaṭṭhānīyānaṃ dhammānaṃ āyatiṃ vipākaṃ pajānāti,
an3.112:5.4: tad abhinivaddhetvā cetasā abhivirājetvā paññāya ativijjha passati.
an3.112:5.5: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave atīte chandarāgaṭṭhānīye dhamme ārabbha chando na jāyati. 3.
an3.112:6.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave anāgate chandarāgaṭṭhānīye dhamme ārabbha chando na jāyati?
an3.112:6.2: Anāgatānaṃ bhikkhave chandarāgaṭṭhānīyānaṃ dhammānaṃ āyatiṃ vipākaṃ pajānāti,
an3.112:6.4: tad abhinivaddhetvā cetasā abhivirājetvā paññāya ativijjha passati.
an3.112:6.5: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave anāgate chandarāgaṭṭhānīye dhamme ārabbha chando na jāyati. 4.
an3.112:7.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave paccuppanne chandarāgaṭṭhānīye dhamme ārabbha chando na jāyati?
an3.112:7.2: Paccuppannānaṃ bhikkhave chandarāgaṭṭhānīyānaṃ dhammānaṃ āyatiṃ vipākaṃ pajānāti, āyatiṃ vipākaṃ viditvā tad abhinivaddheti, tad abhinivaddhetvā cetasā abhivirājetvā paññāya ativijjha passati.
an3.112:7.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave paccuppanne chandarāgaṭṭhānīye dhamme ārabbha chando na jāyati.
an3.112:7.4: Imāni kho bhikkhave tīṇi nidānāni kammānaṃ samudayāyā ti. 111.
